product_one_liner.value: Malachyte provides retailers and e-commerce teams with AI-powered personalized search, recommendations, and page experiences that adapt to each shopper in real time.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page describes search, recommendations, and page-level personalization; the About page identifies retailers as its audience.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation has no Pricing link, and the available research says Malachyte does not publish rate-card pricing; no public pricing page was identified.

named_customers.notes: Both are named customer logos linked to case studies on the company site.

employee_band.notes: Dealroom reports 17 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: Dealroom lists Malachyte’s HQ location as New York City, United States.

founded_year.notes: Dealroom identifies Malachyte as founded in 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The index includes an architecture/continuous-learning post by co-founder and CTO Ian Anderson and a technical case study co-authored by Malachyte staff ML engineer Vicki Boykis; this meets the two-post technical-content threshold.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal includes multiple setup guides and product references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page says there are no open positions right now.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product docs, technology page, blog, and subprocessors identify Malachyte’s Vector AI/LLM approach and Google Cloud infrastructure, but do not specify a foundation-model provider or named model.

compliance_certs.notes: The company states “SOC II – Type 1 certified.”

last_funding.notes: Malachyte announced a $10 million seed round on August 6, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The announced August 2026 seed funding falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page says there are no open positions right now.

launched_6mo.notes: TechCrunch reports the product became generally available to Shopify merchants in June 2026, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Di Lyngholm’s resume identifies her as VP of Product & Growth at Malachyte and says her full-time role began in April 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is named on the pilot-program page, which discusses connecting CRM systems.
